steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: GPP = total photosynthesis; NPP = GPP - R (respiration); Efficiency = energy transferred/total available x100% (typically 10%); Pyramids: energy always upright; biomass can be inverted

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Carbon: photosynthesis, respiration, combustion, decomposition, ocean uptake; Nitrogen: fixation (lightning, bacteria), nitrification (ammonia->nitrite->nitrate), assimilation, denitrification

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Growth curves: lag, log, stationary, death; Carrying capacity K; r/K selection; Predator-prey: Lotka-Volterra cycles

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Succession: pioneer -> intermediate -> climax; each stage modifies environment for next; Deflected succession: human interference

steps.title: Worked example
steps.body: Q: Explain why only ~10% of energy transfers between trophic levels --- Solution: Energy lost as: heat (respiration), faeces (undigested), urine (excretion), uneaten parts. Only energy in consumed biomass available to next level. 2nd law of thermodynamics: entropy increases

steps.title: Try it yourself
steps.body: Define GPP and NPP | Describe nitrogen fixation | Draw logistic growth curve, label K and r
